questions.question: HUN is a cultural festival celebrated in which Indian State ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hun is a cultural festival **__celebrated by the Thadou community in the __**Indian state of Manipur.**__
 
• It is considered the most important festival among all their celebrations and is **celebrated for seven days.**
 
• The word “**Hun**” **signifies **time and season according to the Thadous, and it marks the arrival of the **New Year for the Thadou tribe.**
 
• During the festival, the Thadou people come together to honour their customs, culture, and religious beliefs.
 
• The festival **serves as a platform for the leaders to assess the state of affairs in their chiefdom.**
 
• It is also a time to acknowledge the labour of women and **appreciate their contributions to Thadou society.**
 
 
• The 5th edition of the festival was held at Thomas Ground in Kangpokpi district and was attended by dignitaries, including the Chief Minister of Manipur, state ministers, MLA, top civil and police officers.

questions.question: Which of the following tribe's people are craftsmen?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Karmali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Karmali tribe is one of the **oldest tribes in Jharkhand.** They are known for their expertise in various crafts, including:

 
 
• **Blacksmithy:** Karmali men are skilled blacksmiths who create a variety of iron implements, such as tools, weapons, and household items.
 
• **Wood carving**: Karmali women are skilled wood carvers who create beautiful objects, such as furniture, sculptures, and decorative items.
 
• **Pottery**: Karmali people are also skilled potters who create a variety of earthenware objects, such as pots, bowls, and lamps.
 
• **Basket weaving:** Karmali women are skilled basket weavers who create a variety of baskets and other woven objects, such as mats, bags, and fans.

• Warli painting, a style of tribal art, mostly created by the tribal people from the North Sahyadri Range in India.
 
• The Warli tribe is one of the largest in India, located outside of Mumbai.

questions.question: 'Operation Prosperity Guardian', is recently seen in news, with respect to this Which one of the following statements best reflects about Operation Prosperity Guardian?

options.text: A multinational coalition to respond the Houthi-led attacks on shipping in the Red Sea.
A coalition under International Court of Justice for world peace.
Global climate change initiative to support least developed countries.
It is initiative under UN Security Council for maintaining peace in middle east.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] __In News__**

__
 
• **The Hindu: **The Pentagon has recently announced an international mission to counter the growing number of attacks against Israel-bound international traffic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__****Operation Prosperity Guardian:**

 
• In December 2023, an international security coalition, known as "**Operation Prosperity Guardian", **was established **in response to the Houthi-led attacks on shipping vessels in the Red Sea. *Hence option 1 is the correct answer.***
 
• US Defense Secretary, Lloyd Austin, announced the formation of this **multinational maritime security alliance,** the primary **objective of which is to combat the Houthi forces who have been threatening international maritime trade **with their ongoing attacks against commercial ships.
 
• As per Austin, "The increasing and reckless Houthi strikes from Yemen are violating international law, endangering innocent seafarers, and posing a threat to the smooth movement of trade".
 
• **"Operation Prosperity Guardian" unites various countries such as the United Kingdom, Bahrain, Canada, France, Italy, Netherlands, Norway, Seychelles, and Spain.**
 
• These countries come together to collectively confront the security issues emerging in the southern Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden.
 
• What has been observed, however, is that Egypt and Saudi Arabia - two significant regional players - are nowhere to be seen on the list of participants. Nevertheless, it has not been ruled out that various nations, choosing not to publicly state their involvement, might also be part of this operation.

 [IMAGE: https://i.guim.co.uk/img/media/2f691752f5acde517ccc510effc715d2b72ec888/62_0_2420_1452/master/2420.jpg?width=465&dpr=1&s=none]
